name: AE project edit IR schema
scope: Neutral edit intent for AEPX dry-run/apply planning and JSX transaction generation.

source_project.path: explicit user-selected source path or synthetic placeholder

output_project.path: explicit new output path; never inferred from source
output_project.overwrite: boolean, must be false in v0

generated_jsx.path: explicit generated .jsx path for JSX route, pairwise distinct from source/output
generated_jsx.overwrite: boolean, must be false in v0
generated_jsx.include_ir_payload: boolean, true means embedded JSON data only

operations.kind: rename_comp | rename_layer | set_comment | set_marker | replace_text_source | relink_asset_path

target.kind: project | comp | layer | marker | text_source | asset

selector.xml_id: AEPX stable XML id when available
selector.name: exact item/comp name fallback
selector.comp_ae_item_id: AE comp item id when targeting an owned layer, marker, or text source
selector.layer_index: 1-based AE layer index when accepted by JSX route
selector.asset_path: exact asset source path for relink
selector.marker_index: zero-based marker index when updating an existing marker

operations.expected_old_value: required guard for every mutating operation; mismatch must fail before mutation
operations.user_supplied: boolean, must be true for text replacement, comments, markers, and relink paths

operation_requirements.new_value: user-supplied marker object with time/comment fields

adapter_report.request_pair_manifest_output: optional jsx_request_pair_manifest_json artifact emitted by ae_project_edit_ir
adapter_report.manual_smoke_closeout_template_output: optional manual_smoke_closeout_template_json artifact emitted by ae_project_edit_ir only after a planned request

path_summary.source_project_path: caller-supplied path only; no project payload
path_summary.observed_source_file_bytes: filesystem metadata only; null when source is absent or not a regular file
path_summary.output_exists: filesystem existence check only; adapter still performs no write
path_summary.generated_jsx_exists: filesystem existence check only; adapter still performs no write

downstream_jsx_validation.validate_request_output: optional jsx_validate_request_json artifact emitted by ae_project_edit_ir
downstream_jsx_validation.scope: no-AE validation request only; generated JSX and project writes remain separate explicit steps

binding.checksum_scope: metadata-only manifest binding; excludes request bodies and private patch payloads

cryptographic_digest.digest_scope: metadata-only manifest digest; excludes request bodies and private patch payloads

notes: This IR is edit intent only; it does not parse or write binary .aep.
AEPX and JSX routes consume the same operation vocabulary but may support different subsets at a given implementation milestone.
Top-level tool modes must not drift into operations[].kind.
Unknown publication status fails closed before writes.
Generated JSX must remain a fixed interpreter over JSON data, not arbitrary JavaScript.
IR adapter reports expose route_gates so callers can see JSX execution, JSX artifact, and AEPX write boundaries before invoking downstream tools.

IR adapter jsx_artifact_gate remains not_written because the adapter emits JSON request artifacts only; generated JSX creation is a separate ae_jsx_transaction generate step using create-new semantics.
IR adapter path_summary is metadata-only: it may record caller paths, normalized paths, existence flags, and source byte length, but project_body_read remains false.
IR adapter must reject existing output project or generated JSX paths before emitting a downstream JSX transaction request.
IR adapter may emit a validate-mode JSX transaction request for downstream dry-run validation; that validate request must not launch AE, write generated JSX, or write a project.
IR adapter may emit a metadata-only JSX request-pair manifest; it must not embed request bodies or private patch payloads.
Request-pair manifests must keep human_approval_gate as required_pending until an explicit external approval receipt exists.
Approval receipts are separate artifacts and do not permit source overwrite or direct binary .aep writing.
Manual smoke protocol is copy-project-only, review-packet checked, approval-gated, and human-operated; tools must not launch AE or execute JSX.
Manual smoke closeout templates are emitted as not-run sanitized evidence shells only; operator-filled reports are not automated AE oracles.
Request-pair manifests now expose a metadata-only non-cryptographic binding checksum. It is for local artifact matching, not tamper-proof security, and it does not cover private patch payload bodies.
Automated tests use synthetic expectation fixtures and never launch After Effects.
AEPX apply remains blocked until an XML writer proves preservation of unknown nodes, attributes, comments, CDATA, namespaces, declaration, encoding, and whitespace.
AEX and FFX data remain opaque; this IR must not depend on .aex loading or .ffx parsing.
